purpose: Conditional sensitivity of the current clustering procedure to fitted-model network resampling, separate from the completed fixed-input initialization study.

sources.simulation: W01-W08 Gaussian conditions, predetermined repetition 1; r in {1.5,4}, sigma in {1.5,4}, h in {1,3}. These are source-condition labels, not restrictions on the fitted bootstrap parameters.
sources.real: STARmap and MERFISH, expression-derived graph and spatial attributes; fixed archived inputs.
sources.selection: No selection by ARI. All eight Gaussian source conditions and both datasets included.

base: Refit all four methods on each observed input using its predetermined initialization and downstream seeds. The resulting current-Proposed hard partition is the bootstrap anchor; original truth/reference labels enter scoring only.

bootstrap_model.labels: Fixed source Proposed hard partition; fixed original node identities and community sizes. No resampling of memberships or community means.
bootstrap_model.edge_probability: Raw observed block edge density among eligible distinct-node pairs. No 0.001 algorithmic clipping in the generator. Singleton-block diagonal probability is zero because there are no eligible pairs.
bootstrap_model.symmetry: Independent Bernoulli for unordered distinct-node pairs, symmetric adjacency, zero diagonal. If sample_sbm is used, invert the community-order permutation before applying the graph to original node attributes.
bootstrap_model.attributes: Community sample mean and MLE covariance (centered cross-product divided by community size) plus 1e-6 I. Each joint-bootstrap attribute row is independently Gaussian conditional on fixed anchor.
bootstrap_model.covariance_diagnostics: Archive community sizes, unregularized covariance rank, minimum eigenvalues, trace(Sigma)/D, and regularization. Low-rank plug-in covariance can make joint-bootstrap stability optimistic.
bootstrap_model.edge_check: Sum expected edge probabilities must equal the observed number of undirected edges, apart from floating-point tolerance.

arms.graph_only: Regenerate A* and retain the exact original X.
arms.joint: Use the same A* as the paired graph_only replicate, and draw X* under the fitted community Gaussian distributions.

initialization.procedure: Run Louvain on each current input graph (observed or resampled) to estimate K, then attribute K-means with nstart=5 and iter.max=10. Never warm-start from the bootstrap anchor.
initialization.comparison: Proposed and Pure share the new K-means partition; standalone Louvain and KMeans_estK are those reference partitions.
initialization.randomness: Source init_seed is held fixed across observed data and bootstrap replicates. Restore source fit_seed downstream state for every Proposed/Pure fit. This conditions on chosen algorithm random streams; different data-dependent paths may consume different draws.

pure.backend: vectorized R implementation retaining the per-pair denominator floor

execution.runtime: diagnostic only; this is not a formal timing study

primary_statistics: ARI against each method original-data partition
Within-anchor coassignment retention and between-anchor false merge proportions
Errors, caps, normal stopping, initialization/fit warnings
secondary_statistics: Agreement with fixed original truth/reference annotations is contextual only. Under bootstrap, the generator labels are the fitted anchor, not these original annotations.
summaries: Per fixed source, arm, method: planned/returned/error/cap counts, mean, sample SD/variance, median/IQR, empirical 5%-95% range, MCSE of the conditional bootstrap mean. With B=50, tail summaries and rare-event frequencies are coarse. Paired arm differences use the 50 shared-graph pairs, not 100 independent replicates.
interpretation_limits: A model-based conditional stability diagnostic, not a proven confidence interval or concentration inequality for original-data ARI.
Stable reproduction of an erroneous source partition is not true-community accuracy; source ARI against original labels is always displayed.
All methods operate under a generator fitted around Proposed; this is not an independent universal superiority benchmark.
Fixed algorithm random seeds separate this study from random-initialization variation; do not call it total uncertainty or a complete variance decomposition.
Joint resampling assumes estimated Gaussian attributes. Source h=3 is not a guarantee that fitted covariance scales retain that ratio.
Real graphs arise from 6NN construction. Bernoulli SBM resampling does not reproduce kNN-construction dependence or the original biological sampling process.
Keep all errors and cap-reaching runs. Valid cap partitions remain in descriptive score summaries, with stopping rates separately disclosed.
This B=50 resampling study is distinct from the cancelled 30-new-seed extension of prior experiments.

references.title: Bootstrapping Networks with Latent Space Structure
references.use: Model-based whole-network resampling and limitations of transferring validity to arbitrary statistics; not an ARI theorem for this procedure.

references.title: Bootstrapping Exchangeable Random Graphs
references.use: Estimated-network-model bootstrap as methodological context; motif-density guarantees do not establish clustering/ARI coverage here.

references.title: Non-Parametric Standard Errors and Tests for Network Statistics
references.use: Why ordinary case resampling needs special handling for graph node duplication and exchangeability.
